project.description: Case field definitions (plain Java, no Spring, no runtime dependencies): the field model per entity and product (types, rules, flags), checking and normalising values with stable codes, the rules for changing a definition (key and type locked once values exist, removing = switching off), the field list file (platform-fields/1) with import by key, the field value delivery (platform-field-values/1) and its verifier, and Postgres storage of definitions (fld_ tables, SQL in db/platform/fields, run only by the app's schema step).
